routes.label: from the Ministry of the Interior
at the Palestinian Mission in Germany, about 4 to 8 weeks

note: The Palestinian Mission in Germany's requirements for a first biometric Palestinian passport with a national number (the PDF its Passports page links to, read 2026-10-31; its Arabic is quoted as pdftotext extracts it, with the extraction's letter-order errors): the fee is 60 euros, including postage, paid by transfer to the Mission's account; the same 60 euros for a child under 18's passport; the passport is issued in roughly four to eight weeks, written as 8 weeks. These are the Berlin mission's fee and time; other missions' were not read. At home, the Ministry of the Interior's fee in shekels wasn't found (its pages hold none; the Cabinet's service guide doesn't answer), so the home route is left unpaid. The validity is not stated.
